purpose: Ross momentum stock selection + 5m opening-range breakout/retest; quote-only advisor; user submits all real orders

risk.initial_stop_rule: actual first-fill average times 90%, rounded up to cent; broker hard protection; never loosen

schedule.source_cutoff: actual observed quote/event time; never backdate a delayed run to 09:05
schedule.late_start: no new position if premarket watchlist was not frozen by 09:25 ET
schedule.winter_policy: premarket-only because regular open is 22:30 HK; no ORB entries

technical.breakout: first completed minute strictly above frozen opening-range high after first 5 minutes
technical.retest: later minute low <= ORH and close > ORH and close > open; first touch must confirm
technical.failure: any post-breakout close <= ORH invalidates that attempt; touch without bullish confirmation invalidates; fresh breakout required
technical.momentum_confirmation: confirmation close above as-of regular HLC3 volume-weighted proxy and volume above mean of prior five complete minute volumes
technical.structural_stop: retest low minus one verified tick is an early invalidation level, evaluated on completed minute close; not assumed broker stop
known_resistance_sources: premarket high observed by frozen cutoff
technical.target: no fixed profit exit or profit order; calculate net 2x structural-loss reference only to assess room before known resistance; this is not 2x hard-stop risk
technical.break_even_and_trailing: after at least +1 structural R estimated net liquidation gain, propose higher confirmed 5m pivot protection; two later 5m bars must confirm pivot; user acknowledgement required
technical.adaptation_not_original_claim: 1m confirmation, fixed filters, volume/VWAP gate, limits and net 2R are our predeclared implementation; profitability unvalidated
technical.profit_exit: completed minute close below initial retest invalidation; or two complete closes below VWAP with lower latest close than previous low and latest volume at least prior-five mean; hard stop, adverse news and 22:20 exit also apply; no fixed profit target

news.window: current plus previous two US trading sessions
news.A: original verified earnings with quantified improvement and/or raised guidance, material quantified contract, or completed positive regulatory result
news.B: verified current event with mixed or incomplete economics; requires technical and risk gates
news.pending: future scheduled report, rumor, or unverified time/source
news.adverse: confirmed current dilution/financing pressure or negative guidance/material adverse fact; exclude new entry until separately reviewed

fees.model: Huatai HK V2 known-fee estimates only; actual bill/permissions still require user confirmation
fees.Q4_2026_TAF: use zero only when broker pass-through is confirmed; otherwise conservative listed amount

manual_execution.initial_stop_rounding: up to next cent after actual first-fill average times 90%
manual_execution.missing_position_or_cash_state: publish conditional plan; withhold executable BUY/ADD instructions
manual_execution.actual_fill_policy: derive 10% hard protection from actual first-fill average and actual remaining shares; recompute hard risk and structural R; early structure exit is not guaranteed and cannot release sizing risk
manual_execution.runtime_monitoring: scheduled checks with latency; not continuous tick monitoring; missed or expired signals remain WAIT

required_fields: hard stop and structural invalidation separately
2x structural R reference only; no fixed profit order

retrospective_limit: V2.3 adds evidence context and market freshness gates; synthetic tests do not validate returns.
status: Public illustrative configuration; set your own local risk parameters

asset_context.dashboard_access: Authenticated loopback backend with private HTTPS remote proxy
